text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her run in the Fantasy Stakes was 
breathtaking. What's more, it turned out 
her shoe was broken after the race. This 
story might just boost her popularity—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer launches a 4-koma blog! After 
thanking them, Aston Machan unilaterally 
declares her next goal to be the Hanshin 
JF.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, around that time, one of her 
rivals, Vodka, was vigorously training, 
quietly setting her sights on an upcoming 
race!
